name: Breachers: Outbreak
summary:
**You already know how to breach; now you will learn how to survive.**

Set in the universe of Breachers, **Breachers: Outbreak** is a 4-player co-op zombie extraction shooter where you and your friends are dropped into infected quarantine zones to recover the key to preventing an undead apocalypse.
